prompt:
Write a React TypeScript `KpiStatsCard` component with `title: string`, `value: string | number`, `changePercentage?: number`, `changeType?: 'positive' | 'negative' | 'neutral'`. Render title, value, and an accessible change indicator with `aria-label` describing the change (e.g. `+12% increase` or `-5% decrease`).
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `KpiStatsCard`.

Write a React TypeScript `VideoPlayerControls` component with `isPlaying: boolean`, `isMuted: boolean`, `onTogglePlay: () => void`, `onToggleMute: () => void`. Render Play/Pause button `aria-label="Play"` / `aria-label="Pause"` and Mute/Unmute button `aria-label="Mute"` / `aria-label="Unmute"`.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `VideoPlayerControls`.

Write a React TypeScript `GalleryLightboxViewer` component with `images: string[]`, `currentIndex: number`, `isOpen: boolean`, `onIndexChange: (idx: number) => void`, `onClose: () => void`. Render dialog with current image, Next button `aria-label="Next image"`, Prev button `aria-label="Previous image"`, and Close button `aria-label="Close gallery"`.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `GalleryLightboxViewer`.

Write a React TypeScript `HorizontalSplitPane` component with `leftPane: React.ReactNode`, `rightPane: React.ReactNode`, `initialSplit?: number` (percentage, default 50). Render both panes with a resizable divider handle with `role="separator"` and `aria-valuenow`.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `HorizontalSplitPane`.

Write a React TypeScript `SlugUrlInput` component with `baseUrl: string`, `value: string`, `onChange: (slug: string) => void`. Convert space-separated text to lowercase-kebab-case automatically. Render text input with `aria-label='URL slug'` and display the full URL preview inside an element with `data-testid='url-preview'`.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `SlugUrlInput`.

Write a React TypeScript `SearchHighlightInput` component with `query: string`, `onQueryChange: (q: string) => void`, `text: string`. Render search input with `aria-label='Search text'` and a content container with `data-testid='highlight-content'`. Matches of `query` in `text` should be wrapped in `<mark>` elements (case-insensitive).
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `SearchHighlightInput`.

Write a React TypeScript `KpiGaugeChart` component with `value: number`, `min?: number` (default 0), `max?: number` (default 100), `label: string`. Render container with `role='progressbar'`, `aria-valuenow={value}`, `aria-valuemin={min}`, `aria-valuemax={max}`, displaying value and label.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `KpiGaugeChart`.

Write a React TypeScript `TruncatedTextWithMore` component with `text: string`, `maxLength?: number` (default 100). If text exceeds `maxLength`, truncate with ellipsis and render a toggle button 'Show more' / 'Show less'. Clicking button toggles full text.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `TruncatedTextWithMore`.

Write a React TypeScript `DatePresetButtons` component with `presets: Array<{ id: string; label: string }>`, `activeId?: string`, `onSelect: (id: string) => void`. Render buttons for each preset with `aria-pressed={id === activeId}`. Clicking button fires `onSelect(id)`.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `DatePresetButtons`.

Write a React TypeScript custom hook `useClickAwayListener(ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, onClickAway: () => void): void`. It should listen to `mousedown` on `document` and trigger `onClickAway` when clicked outside the referenced element.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `useClickAwayListener`.

Write a React TypeScript custom hook `useWindowDimensions(): { width: number; height: number }`. It should return current `window.innerWidth` and `window.innerHeight`, updating on `window` resize event.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `useWindowDimensions`.

Write a React TypeScript custom hook `useToggleState(initialValue?: boolean): [boolean, () => void, (value: boolean) => void]`. It should return the boolean state, a toggle function that inverts it, and a setter function that sets explicit boolean.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `useToggleState`.

Write a React TypeScript custom hook `useIntervalTimer(callback: () => void, delayMs: number | null): void`. It should execute `callback` every `delayMs` milliseconds, pausing if `delayMs` is null.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `useIntervalTimer`.

Write a React TypeScript custom hook `useNetworkStatusState(): { isOnline: boolean }`. It tracks `navigator.onLine` and listens to `window` 'online' and 'offline' events.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `useNetworkStatusState`.

Write a React TypeScript `MasonryGrid` component with `columns?: number` (default 3), `children: React.ReactNode[]`. Render container with `role='grid'` and distribution of children across columns.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `MasonryGrid`.

Write a React TypeScript `CollapsibleCard` component with `title: string`, `children: React.ReactNode`, `defaultOpen?: boolean`. Render card with header toggle button `aria-expanded` and card content panel that hides when collapsed.
IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `CollapsibleCard`.
Build an `AvatarGroup` component that stacks up to a `max` number of `Avatar` children and shows a `+N` overflow badge for the rest.

Write a collapsible `Sidebar` nav component with an `isCollapsed` boolean state that animates its width via a CSS transition. Set `aria-expanded` on the root element (with `data-testid="sidebar"`) to the inverse of `isCollapsed`.

Write a `MultiStepForm` wizard component that manages the current step index and renders only that step's `children`, exposing `onNext`/`onBack`. Accept a `steps: React.ReactNode[]` prop and render a 'Next' button.
Write a custom hook `useKeyPress(targetKey: string): boolean` that returns whether the given key is currently held down.
Write a generic custom hook `useFetch<T>(url: string): {data: T | null, error: Error | null, loading: boolean}` using `fetch` with `AbortController` cleanup on unmount or url change.
Write a custom hook `useInterval(callback: () => void, delayMs: number | null)` where passing `null` pauses the interval, cleaning it up on unmount.
Build an `ErrorBoundary` typed with `componentDidCatch` and a `fallback: React.ReactNode | ((error: Error) => React.ReactNode)` prop that supports both a static node and a render function.
Style a `Card` component with a CSS module using a responsive grid layout (`display: grid`) that collapses from 3 columns to 1 column below a 640px viewport width.
Style a `Card` component's hover state with a smooth `transform: translateY(-4px)` and `box-shadow` transition, using plain CSS with no libraries.
Write custom scrollbar styles (`::-webkit-scrollbar`) in a `ScrollableList` component's CSS module, with a `scrollbar-width: thin` fallback for Firefox.
Build a `MediaFrame` layout component using CSS `aspect-ratio: 16 / 9` to keep an embedded video or image at a fixed ratio regardless of container width.
Style an RTL-aware `Sidebar` component using CSS logical properties (`margin-inline-start`, `padding-inline-end`) instead of physical `left`/`right`.

Style `Input` form components with distinct CSS classes for `:invalid`, `:focus`, and a `data-error='true'` attribute-driven error state. Set `data-error="true"`/`"false"` on the input based on whether the `error` prop is present.
Write a useToggle boolean state hook
Create an accessible dark-mode audio player with volume slider and playlist
